name: tailwindcss-fundamentals-v4

metadata.name: tailwindcss-fundamentals-v4
metadata.PROACTIVELY activate for: (1) installing Tailwind v4 (Vite plugin, PostCSS, CLI), (2) CSS-first configuration with @theme, (3) @import "tailwindcss" syntax, (4) v3-to-v4 migration, (5) new utilities introduced in v4 (text-shadow, mask-*, container queries), (6) Lightning CSS engine, (7) zero-config content detection, (8) Oxide engine performance, (9) @utility for custom utilities, (10) @variant for custom variants.
metadata.Provides: v4 install guide, @theme reference, v3-to-v4 migration checklist, new utility catalog, and @utility/@variant examples.
